name: Atlantis
hook: Plato's sunken island: the lost continent every generation keeps finding again.

facts.label: Plato
facts.statement: Plato is the main source of the legend, describing Atlantis in the dialogues Timaeus and Critias around 360 B.C.

facts.label: a lost continent
facts.statement: Atlantis is the legendary island or continent said to have sunk beneath the sea; Mu is its supposed Pacific counterpart.

facts.label: the Minoan civilization
facts.statement: Many think Plato's Atlantis refers to the Minoan civilization on Crete, which flourished about 5,000 years ago and collapsed.

facts.label: the Bimini Road
facts.statement: The Bimini Road, an undersea limestone formation off Florida, is cited by some as evidence of Atlantis.

facts.label: the Canary Islands
facts.statement: Legend makes the seven Canary Islands the highest peaks of sunken Atlantis.

facts.label: Utopia
facts.statement: Atlantis's orderly society is thought to have inspired Thomas More's 1516 Utopia, while Bacon's New Atlantis may have inspired the Royal Society.

facts.label: Helike
facts.statement: The drowned city of Helike, a center of Poseidon worship found in 2001, has been called 'the real Atlantis.'
